items.t: Lower intake manifold gasket coolant leak
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: CarComplaints owners report typical bills of about $600 to $900. Add more if the coolant has damaged the engine bearings.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping, harsh shifts or failure
items.job: Repair valve body or replace the automatic transmission
items.note: Owner-reported costs range from a $1,400 repair quote to about $3,500 for replacement.

items.t: Steering gets stiff or binds in left turns (recall)
items.job: Replace lower pinion bearing or steering rack (recall)

items.t: Stalls while driving or cranks but won't start
items.job: Diagnose and replace the failed part (engine computer, ignition module or fuel pump)
items.note: CarComplaints lists average owner costs of about $800 to $1,400 for the top no-start and stalling problems.

items.t: Head gasket failure and overheating
items.job: Replace head gaskets
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $1,200. Engine replacement runs higher.

items.t: Oil can leak onto the exhaust and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair of the valve cover oil leak

items.t: Passenger airbag may be missing a check pin (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair passenger airbag (recall)

items.t: Airbags failed to deploy or went off without a crash
items.job: Scan and diagnose the airbag (SRS) system
items.note: RepairPal lists electrical system diagnosis at $122 to $179. If a part such as the clockspring has failed, RepairPal shows $416 to $473 for that job.

items.t: Power steering cuts out in wet weather
items.job: Replace drive belt tensioner and belt
items.note: RepairPal estimates $201 to $265 for the tensioner. If the pump is at fault, RepairPal lists $456 to $526.

items.t: Warped rotors and fast brake wear
items.job: Replace front brake pads (rotors extra if warped)
items.note: YourMechanic puts pad replacement at about $200 to $500 per axle. New rotors add to that.

items.t: ABS problems: light on or pump runs on its own
items.job: ABS and brake system inspection and code read
items.note: RepairPal estimates $122 to $179 for the inspection. A failed wheel speed sensor or ABS part costs extra.

items.t: No-start from the anti-theft system (Passlock)
items.job: Anti-theft diagnosis; replace ignition switch/lock sensor if failed
items.note: RepairPal lists anti-theft diagnosis at $61 to $90 and ignition switch replacement at $386 to $443.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
items.job: Diagnose fuel gauge and fuel level sender
items.note: RepairPal lists electrical diagnosis at $122 to $179. Replacing the sender means dropping the tank and costs more.

items.t: Misfire from a failing ignition module or plug wires
items.job: Replace spark plug wires or ignition control module
items.note: RepairPal estimates $119 to $180 for plug wires and $558 to $719 for the ignition control module.

items.t: Oil leak from the oil pan or rear main seal
items.job: Replace oil pan gasket
items.note: YourMechanic averages about $468 and quotes up to about $720 for a 1996 Lumina. A rear main seal costs more because the transmission must come out.

items.t: Accelerator pedal hard to press or cable comes apart
items.job: Inspect accelerator pedal and throttle cable
items.note: YourMechanic lists the inspection at about $95 to $112. A new cable is extra.

items.t: Power door locks stop working
items.job: Replace door lock actuator (one door)

items.t: Daytime running lights won't turn off
items.job: Diagnose DRL module and light switch wiring
items.note: RepairPal lists electrical system diagnosis at $122 to $179. Parts are extra.

items.t: Popping noise from the front on slow turns
items.job: Replace front strut mount or strut assembly (one side)
items.note: RepairPal estimates $374 to $507 for a strut replacement.

items.t: Fuel smell or leak from the tank or fuel lines
items.job: Inspect for fuel leak
items.note: RepairPal lists a leak inspection at $122 to $179. Replacing a rusted tank or line costs more.
